UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Operational civic account profile for Routix users (Workers, Engineers, Municipality Officers, Government Authorities). Contains no PII.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Full display name of the civic user or crew lead.

role.description: Verified active RBAC role assigned by server/admin.

requestedRole.description: Role requested by the user during onboarding or role upgrade.

approvalStatus.description: Verification status for privileged civic roles.

organization.description: Department, municipal ward office, contractor squad, or government agency.

wardZone.description: Assigned municipal ward or operating road corridor.

badgeNumber.description: Employee ID, contractor license, or municipal officer badge code.

specialty.description: Operational specialty (e.g. IRC:SP:100 Cold-Mix, PSI Triage, Escrow Audit).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Strictly isolated PII record for a user account (email, phone, DBT bank handle, office address).

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent user document ID.

phone.description: Contact phone number for field dispatch or official alerts.

dbtHandle.description: Masked DBT bank/UPI reference or treasury disbursal code.

officeAddress.description: Assigned ward depot or municipal office address.

RoleAccessRequest.title: RoleAccessRequest
RoleAccessRequest.description: Verification request submitted by a user to activate Engineer, Municipality Officer, or Government Authority access.

uid.description: Requester Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

justification.description: Brief verification note for authority approval.

status.description: Review state controlled by Government/Admin authority.

reviewedByUid.description: UID of the admin authority who reviewed this request (empty when pending).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last request update.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Trusted admin lookup record granting Government/Root Authority privileges.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin privilege was provisioned.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user Routix application settings (theme, default view, ward, heatmap, IMU sensitivity, notifications).

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

defaultTab.description: Initial workspace tab opened on launch.

defaultWard.description: Preferred municipal ward or road corridor.

defaultHeatmapOn.description: Whether the Live Map opens with the density heatmap enabled.

autoUseGps.description: Automatically attempt GPS lock when opening camera hazard reporting.

highSeverityAlerts.description: Highlight critical PSI >= 85 corridor hazards in alerts.

imuSensitivity.description: Passive smartphone IMU vertical-g shock threshold.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

ReportHistoryEntry.title: ReportHistoryEntry
ReportHistoryEntry.description: Per-user history record of potholes and road hazards reported via Camera or AI Detect (no embedded images).

hazardId.description: Linked Routix hazard ticket ID (e.g. HZ-1054).

source.description: Capture source used to report the hazard.

status.description: Ticket lifecycle status at time of log or sync.

estimatedCostInr.description: Estimated cold-mix repair cost in INR.

reportedAt.description: ISO timestamp string of the report.

/users/{userId}.description: Operational civic account profiles for Engineers, Workers, Municipality Officers, and Government Authorities.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection (email, phone, DBT bank handle, office address) readable only by the account owner or admin.

/role_requests/{userId}.description: Role verification queue for privileged civic roles awaiting Government/Admin review.

/user_settings/{userId}.description: Per-user Routix application preferences synced across devices.

/report_history/{reportId}.description: Per-user audit trail of reported potholes and road hazards.
